parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory. Per the decision rules, any record under Examples/ or SampleApp/ triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The first record is a production method in the DebugPanel package ('Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift', line 100), making this a classic mixed cluster. Consolidating these two would couple the production DebugPanel implementation to sample-app demonstration semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
